summary.text: 这 is the standardized simplified counterpart of 這, used for “this” and “here.” The traditional graph also has a separately attested older verb use meaning “meet” or “receive”; no established link connects that verb to the demonstrative.

formation.text: This entry is a derived form: 这 is the simplified counterpart of 這. In analyses of the traditional graph’s older “meet/receive” verb use, 辶 is semantic and 言 is phonetic. A Warring States manuscript graph containing 酉、口、言 has also been proposed as 這 in that verb sense. These accounts do not establish the demonstrative’s origin or the internal construction of 这.

history.text: The supplied evidence identifies 这 as the simplified counterpart of 這 but does not document the graphic steps or date the standardization. No character-specific historical glyph sequence is available here.

For traditional 這, a Warring States manuscript graph has been proposed as an example of the older verb “meet/receive.” Accounts report that 這 is absent from oracle-bone and bronze inscriptions and from Shuowen; this does not provide a continuous graphic history.

uncertainties.text: The demonstrative’s origin remains unresolved. Proposals involve 者, 之, and 遮; reported Tang spellings and a proposed handwriting confusion with 遮 do not determine which account is correct.

The older verb and the demonstrative are documented separately, with no demonstrated semantic bridge or proof that the demonstrative borrowed the graph from the verb. The reported Tang examples have not been checked against their underlying dated texts.

Analyses assign 言 a phonetic role in traditional 這, but the available ancient sound evidence does not independently verify that role. The current zhè readings of 這 and 这 do not establish the historical relation.

senses.text: The proximal demonstrative is reported in Tang material, including the expression 這回. This is the earliest attested period reported here, not proof of the word’s original meaning.
The character can refer to a nearby place as well as a nearby thing; the evidence does not establish a separate chronology for this use.

senses.period: Warring States manuscript proposal; exact attestation unresolved
senses.text: A manuscript graph has been proposed as 這 used for a verb meaning “meet” or “receive.” This is a distinct lexical use, with no demonstrated development into the demonstrative.
A reported Yuan drama example uses 這 as an empty metrical filler. Its relation to the demonstrative is not established.

limitations.text: The reported Tang examples attest the demonstrative’s use but do not establish its source. The competing proposals do not connect it to the older verb or establish another source.
The evidence does not establish how the demonstrative use relates to the Yuan metrical filler.
